title: Dorf Ketal arm plans ₹30,000 crore hyperscale data centre park in Maharashtra
source_used: The Economic Times article text, read from the page's own structured data (the pool link is the AMP version, which showed no text)
key_facts: Trentar Private Limited, the technology and infrastructure arm of Dorf Ketal Chemicals, plans to invest ₹30,000 crore to develop a 500 MW green integrated hyperscale data centre park in Maharashtra, according to sources aware of the development.
Dorf Ketal Chemicals is a specialty engineered chemistries company serving the refining and petrochemical industries.
The company may shortly sign an MoU with the Maharashtra government, sources said.
Dorf Ketal Chemicals did not reply to an email query.
The company is evaluating land parcels across Maharashtra and expects to finish in about a month, an industry executive said.
The state government will help coordinate permissions, registrations, approvals, clearances and incentives under prevailing policies and regulations.
quote_evidence: Mumbai: Trentar Private Limited, the technology and infrastructure arm of Dorf Ketal Chemicals, plans to invest ₹30,000 crore to develop a 500 MW green integrated hyperscale data centre park in Maharashtra, sources aware of the development told ET.
The company may shortly sign an MoU with Maharashtra for setting up the facility, sources added.
Dorf Ketal Chemicals did not reply to an email query.
why_it_matters_hint: A large planned data center investment in an Indian state, resting on unnamed sources, with no site chosen and no agreement signed at the time of the report.
event_date: ET report dated 6 Oct 2026 IST (5 Oct 2026 UTC).
notes: Single report from unnamed sources and an industry executive. A later pv magazine India headline of 6 Oct 2026 says Trentar has signed an INR 30,000 crore MoU for the 500 MW project (page blocked by Cloudflare, so not read); the editor may want to update the entry. 1 crore is 10 million, so 30,000 crore is 300 billion rupees.
